that it has priced its offering of $1B aggregate principal amount of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031.

The sale of the notes to the underwriters is expected to settle on September 18, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, and is expected to result in approximately $986.0 million in net proceeds to Axon.
The notes carry an initial conversion rate of 1.5336 Axon shares per $1,000 principal amount, equivalent to a conversion price of about $652.06 per share.
Noteholders can convert under specified conditions before June 15, 2031, and freely convert thereafter until shortly before maturity.
Additionally, in connection with the pricing of the notes, Axon

has entered into privately negotiated capped call transactions with certain of the underwriters and/or their respective affiliates and other financial institutions. The cap price of the capped call transactions will initially be $1,049.94, which represents a premium of 137.5% over the last reported sale price of Axon's common stock of $442.08 per share on Nasdaq on September 15.
Axon shares closed at $442.08, down $48.10 from the prior close. Volume reached approximately 2.76 million shares, nearly four times the stock's average daily volume.

title: Axon prices $1B offering of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031, adds capped calls
